title: Putting It All Together: A Long Weekend

sections.title: One story, nine units
sections.content: This final lesson connects everything from Units 11-19 in a single scenario: a friend's long weekend, combining free time, weather, transport, travel, a hotel stay, feeling unwell, and using Hungarian along the way. The connective tissue running through all of it is the same: present tense plus a time word for plans, possessive suffixes on the thing that's affected, and the right case suffix for movement and location.

items.spanish: Hétvégén Szegedre utazunk, mert engem nagyon érdekel az ottani kiállítás.
items.english: We're traveling to Szeged this weekend, because I'm very interested in the exhibition there.

items.spanish: Előbb villamosra szállunk, aztán a pályaudvaron vonatra.
items.english: First we get on a tram, then at the station a train.

items.spanish: Ha esik az eső, inkább a szállodában maradunk.
items.english: If it rains, we'd rather stay at the hotel.

items.spanish: A szobában nem működik a klíma, ezért reklamálunk a recepción.
items.english: The air conditioning doesn't work in the room, so we complain at reception.

items.spanish: Két napja fáj a torkom, ezért gyógyszert veszek a gyógyszertárban.
items.english: My throat has hurt for two days, so I buy medicine at the pharmacy.

items.spanish: Mostantól többet pihenek, és remélem, hogy hamarosan jobban leszek.
items.english: From now on I'll rest more, and I hope that I'll feel better soon.

sections.content: Notice how many different units this one story borrows from without switching grammar: engem érdekel (Unit 11), kiállítás (Unit 12), villamos/vonat (Unit 14), szálloda (Unit 16), fáj a torkom (Unit 17), and remélem, hogy... (Unit 19) all sit comfortably in the same handful of sentences.
